## Detail

### CNF-001 — eCFR currency metadata inconsistent for Title 34

Live eCFR pages blocked automated retrieval, and search metadata reported inconsistent last-amended and currency dates across Title 34 pages in a single session. Currency was established from the govinfo annual CFR edition and the Cornell mirror instead. SRC-004 is therefore recorded CONFLICTED.

Route: Manual eCFR check before any determination relies on the amendment state of 34 CFR Part 99, 98 or 300.

### CNF-002 — CycloneDX ratified standard and latest specification are different versions

ECMA-424 first edition corresponds to CycloneDX 1.6, while OWASP released specification v1.7 in October 2025 without Ecma ratification, and a 2.0 release was announced but not released. Current version depends on which authority is meant.

Route: The evidence pipeline must state the CycloneDX specVersion it emits rather than referring to CycloneDX generally.

### CNF-003 — Massachusetts personal information is narrower than education-record PII

Personal information under c. 93H and 201 CMR 17.00 requires a name combined with a Social Security number, driver's licence or state ID, or financial account number. Most student-record data does not meet that definition, yet is fully covered by 603 CMR 23.00 and FERPA. Conflating the two regimes would misstate both.

Route: The register keeps the two regimes on separate obligation records and never merges their triggers.

### CNF-004 — Regulated accessibility version differs from the current W3C Recommendation

ADA Title II and the HHS Section 504 rule both name WCAG 2.1 Level AA. The current W3C Recommendation is WCAG 2.2. Building only to the regulated version leaves a re-test cycle; building to 2.2 exceeds what regulation names.

Route: Owner decision recorded through OBL-014, binding ULW-AS-001 v1.3 to a named WCAG version.

### CNF-005 — EOTSS accessibility policy scope unresolved

The Massachusetts enterprise accessibility policy binds executive-branch agencies. Whether and how it reaches school districts or their vendors was not established, and the policy version and conformance level were not retrieved.

Route: Retrieve the policy text and its scope clause before any Massachusetts procurement response.

### CNF-006 — COPPA statutory citation range varies across FTC pages

FTC materials cite both 15 U.S.C. 6501-6505 and 6501-6506 for the same statute.

Route: Confirm against the U.S. Code before the citation appears in any formal memo.
